text:
Predicates:
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
Game(y) ::: y is a game.
Top10(y) ::: y is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Conclusion:
MadeBy(theLegendOfZelda, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y) ::: The Legend of Zelda was created by a Japanese game company.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
( SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) → Top10(theLegendOfZelda) ) ::: If The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
¬Top10(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
